summary: Tested the NEW Project Timeline page (separate tab below Analytics), removal of Project Timeline Tracker from Analytics, and the new Project Planning & Timeline section in RequestDetail. All requested features verified working end-to-end.

design_issues.screen: Dashboard (pre-existing, not related to this iteration)
issues: Console hydration warnings: <span> not a valid child of <tr>/<tbody>/<th>/<td> in DashboardRequestsTable lines 325, 334, 356, 371. Caused by data-ve-dynamic span wrappers being injected inside table semantics. Not a functional bug but pollutes console with React hydration errors on every dashboard load.

Default search by 'PO' substring returned 0 rows during testing because none of the 4 visible projects had 'PO' in PO Number or Project Name; behavior is correct but the dataset is sparse for FY filter tests (FY 2024-25 = 0 rows, Critical priority = 0 rows). Recommend richer seed data for better demo/testing.

action_items: (Optional) Fix pre-existing DashboardRequestsTable hydration warnings (<span> inside table). Not blocking, but pollutes console.
(Optional) Seed more data covering FY 2024-25 and Critical/High priorities so the Project Timeline filters are demonstrable with realistic data.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectTimeline.jsx uses date-range new Date(2025,2,31) which becomes April 1 due to month overflow (March has 31 days, this works but new Date(2026,2,31) = March 31 — minor; verify FY end logic). Currently OK because March has 31 days, but if used with February (month index 1) it would overflow.
ProjectTimeline.jsx fetches axios.get without auth interceptor visibility — works because App.js sets axios.defaults Authorization globally. Confirmed via dashboard navigation that data loads.

Nav item 'Project Timeline' only shown to buyer/capex_head roles (DashboardLayout.jsx:134). Admin (admin@capex.com) will NOT see this nav entry. If admin should also access, add 'admin' to roles array.
